name: Long River's Pull
description: Gift a card. Counter target creature spell. If the gift was promised, instead counter target spell.
couldNotDerive: That the two counter effects are mutually exclusive (gift-gated) rather than both happening -- TargetMin$/TargetMax$ referencing dynamic PromisedGift.N.M SVars aren't resolved, so both nodes render as if unconditional.
notes: Benefited from this batch's A:Counter implementation -- both counter effects now show up as real move(stack->gy) nodes with correct target-type restrictions (creature vs. any). The real card is actually an exclusive 'or' ("counter target creature spell -- INSTEAD counter target spell if gift promised", via TargetMin$X/TargetMax$X = Count$PromisedGift.0.1 zeroing out the first counter when the second fires) -- same unresolved dynamic-quantity class as Dewdrop Cure/Into the Flood Maw, not fixed this round. A real improvement from complete silence to two structurally-correct-but-unconditionally-rendered counters.
